title: How to Appeal a SASSA SRD Grant Decision
description: Lodge a SASSA SRD appeal on the official portal: check the declined month, enter your ID and phone, use the PIN, and follow the 90-day rules.
intro: If SASSA declined your SRD application for a month, you can lodge an appeal with the Independent Tribunal. The appeal is lodged on the official SASSA SRD appeals portal, not at a SASSA branch.
how_it_works: Appeals are lodged on the official portal at srd.sassa.gov.za/appeals/appeal.
You have 90 days from the date of the decision to lodge an appeal. The portal enforces the cutoff.
Enter your 13-digit ID number and the 10-digit phone number used for your SRD application. The portal sends a 6-digit PIN to that phone.
After the PIN is verified, the portal shows the months with declined outcomes. You appeal a specific month, not the whole application.
You must choose an appeal reason from the list the portal shows. You cannot submit new evidence or information that was not available to SASSA when you applied.
The Independent Tribunal must finalise the appeal within 90 days of receiving it and communicate the decision to you.
If the appeal succeeds, the tribunal sets aside SASSA's decision. Payment timing is a separate step and is not guaranteed by the appeal decision.

portal.name: SASSA SRD Appeals Portal
portal.note: Enter your 13-digit ID number and the 10-digit phone number used for your SRD application. The portal then sends a 6-digit PIN to that phone.

steps.title: Open the official appeals portal
steps.text: Go to https://srd.sassa.gov.za/appeals/appeal in a browser. There is no app to download, and you should not pay anyone to lodge an appeal for you.

steps.title: Enter your ID number and phone number
steps.text: Type your 13-digit South African ID number and the 10-digit phone number used on your SRD application. These must match SASSA's records.

steps.title: Send and enter the PIN
steps.text: Tap send pin. A 6-digit PIN is sent to the phone number you entered. Type the PIN into the field that unlocks after your ID and phone are accepted.

steps.title: Open the declined month
steps.text: The portal lists the months with declined outcomes. Open the specific month you want to appeal. If more than one month was declined, each month is handled separately.

steps.title: Choose your appeal reason
steps.text: Select the reason that matches your case, such as identity verification fixed, no alternative income source, or not registered for UIF or NSFAS. The portal supplies the reason list.

steps.title: Submit the appeal
steps.text: Tap apply to record the appeal against that month. Keep a screenshot of the confirmation. The appeal is linked to your ID and the month, so check that month's outcome later rather than looking for a separate reference number.

steps.title: Wait for the tribunal decision
steps.text: The Independent Tribunal must finalise the appeal within 90 days of receiving it. Check the same month's outcome on the portal with a new PIN. The decision is also communicated electronically.

steps.title: Understand the outcome
steps.text: Approved means the tribunal set aside the decline. Declined means it confirmed the decision. If the appeal is refused, check the reason shown and apply again for a later month if your circumstances have changed.

faqs.q: Can I appeal the same declined month more than once?
faqs.a: The portal rejects a second appeal for the same period with the message "appeal exist for this period". If your circumstances change, submit a new SRD application for a later month instead of trying to reopen the same month.

faqs.q: Do I need internet access to appeal?
faqs.a: Yes. The appeal is lodged on the official appeals portal. Ask someone you trust to help you use the site, but never share your PIN or pay an agent to submit an appeal for you.

faqs.q: Do I need to go to a SASSA office to appeal?
faqs.a: The appeal is lodged on the official appeals portal. A branch visit does not replace the portal submission. If you cannot use the portal, call the SASSA helpline on 0800 60 10 11 for help.

faqs.q: How long does a SASSA SRD appeal take?
faqs.a: The Independent Tribunal must finalise the appeal within 90 days from the date it receives the appeal. If that period passes with no outcome, check the portal again and follow up through official SASSA channels.

faqs.q: Can I add new bank statements or affidavits to my appeal?
faqs.a: No. The SRD appeal rules say you may not submit evidence or information that was not provided to SASSA at the time of the application. The tribunal reassesses the decision on the information SASSA already had.

faqs.q: My appeal was approved. When will I be paid?
faqs.a: An approved appeal means the tribunal set aside the declined decision. SASSA must then implement the outcome, but the appeal decision does not create a fixed payment date. Check your SRD status and the SASSA payment schedule.

title: Check a SASSA SRD Appeal Status
description: Check a SASSA SRD appeal with your ID, phone number and PIN on the official portal. See what pending, approved and declined outcomes mean.
intro: You check an SRD appeal on the same official portal where it was lodged. The portal verifies your ID and phone number with a PIN, then shows the outcome recorded for each month.
how_it_works: The official appeals portal is at srd.sassa.gov.za/appeals/appeal.
Enter the 13-digit ID number and the 10-digit phone number used on your SRD application.
The portal sends a 6-digit PIN to that phone. Enter the PIN to unlock the outcome records.
Outcomes are shown per month. Check the specific month you appealed, not a single overall application status.
"Pending" means no decision has been recorded for that month yet. It is not an approval and it is not a new decline.
The Independent Tribunal must finalise the appeal within 90 days of receiving it.
A declined appeal means the tribunal confirmed SASSA's decision for that month. You can apply again for a later month if you still qualify.

portal.name: SASSA SRD Appeals Portal
portal.note: Enter your 13-digit ID number and the 10-digit phone number used for your SRD application. The portal then sends a 6-digit PIN to that phone.

steps.title: Open the official appeals portal
steps.text: Go to https://srd.sassa.gov.za/appeals/appeal. Old guides may list srd-appeals.dsd.gov.za, but that address does not resolve. Use the srd.sassa.gov.za address.

steps.title: Enter your ID and phone number
steps.text: Type your 13-digit ID number and the 10-digit phone number linked to your SRD application.

steps.title: Send and enter the PIN
steps.text: Tap send pin, then enter the 6-digit PIN sent to that phone number.

steps.title: Open the month you appealed
steps.text: The portal shows the months with outcomes. Expand the month you appealed to see the decline reason, the appeal reason and the appeal outcome.

steps.title: Read the outcome carefully
steps.text: No outcome yet means the appeal is still pending. Approved means the decline was set aside. Declined means the tribunal confirmed the decision for that month.

steps.title: Check again later
steps.text: If the appeal is still pending, wait and check again. If more than 90 days have passed since you lodged it, follow up through official SASSA channels with your ID number and the month you appealed.

faqs.q: What does "appeal pending" mean?
faqs.a: It means an appeal has been lodged for that month and the Independent Tribunal has not yet recorded a decision. It is not an approval, and it does not mean the appeal failed. The tribunal must finalise the appeal within 90 days of receiving it.

faqs.q: Can I check my appeal status by SMS, USSD or WhatsApp?
faqs.a: The SRD USSD, WhatsApp and app channels show your grant application status. They do not show the Independent Tribunal's appeal decision. Use the official appeals portal for the appeal outcome.

faqs.q: What if my appeal shows "declined"?
faqs.a: It means the tribunal confirmed SASSA's decision for that month. Read the reason shown. You can submit a new SRD application for a later month if your circumstances change, but the portal will reject a second appeal for the same period.

faqs.q: I did not receive a PIN. What should I do?
faqs.a: The PIN is sent to the phone number on your SRD application. Check that the number is still active and correct. If it changed, update your contact details on the SRD portal first, then try the appeals portal again.

faqs.q: Does the portal show my SRD application status too?
faqs.a: No. The appeals portal shows appeal outcomes for declined months. Use the SRD status check for your monthly grant application status and payment dates.

title: SASSA SRD Appeal Deadline: 90 Days
description: You have 90 days from the decision to lodge an SRD appeal. See how the deadline is counted and what to do if the portal says the cutoff has expired.
intro: There is one statutory window for an SRD appeal. The 90 days run from the date of SASSA's decision, not from the day you happen to notice the status.
how_it_works: Lodge the appeal within 90 days of the date of the decision.
The portal enforces the cutoff. If the period has expired, it returns "appeal cutoff date expired".
The SRD appeal rules say an appeal lodged after the 90-day period will not be considered by the Independent Tribunal.
The 90 days for lodging an appeal is separate from the 90 days the tribunal has to finalise it after receiving it.
If you miss the window, you cannot reopen that month by appeal. You can submit a new SRD application for a later month if you still qualify.
Do not wait for a new month's status before appealing an older declined month. Each month has its own decision and its own window.

steps.title: Find the decision date
steps.text: Check the SRD status portal for the month that was declined. The 90-day window starts from the decision date shown for that month.

steps.title: Lodge before day 90
steps.text: Go to https://srd.sassa.gov.za/appeals/appeal, enter your ID and phone number, then the 6-digit PIN. Open the declined month and submit the appeal with a reason.

steps.title: Keep proof of the submission
steps.text: Take a screenshot of the confirmation. The appeal is linked to your ID and the month, so check that month's outcome later on the same portal.

steps.title: If the deadline has passed
steps.text: The portal will not accept an appeal for that month once the cutoff has expired. Submit a new SRD application for a later month if you still qualify, and do not pay anyone who claims they can reopen a closed appeal.

faqs.q: When does the 90-day appeal window start?
faqs.a: It starts on the date of the decision for the declined month, not on the date you first see the status. Check the decision date on the SRD status portal and count from there.

faqs.q: Can I lodge a late SRD appeal?
faqs.a: The SRD appeal rules say no appeal will be considered if it is not submitted within the 90-day period. Unlike the general appeal regulations, the SRD rules do not provide a late-appeal route. Apply again for a later month if you still qualify.

faqs.q: Is the 90-day deadline the same as the appeal processing time?
faqs.a: No. You have 90 days to lodge the appeal. After the tribunal receives it, the tribunal has a further 90 days to finalise it.

faqs.q: What if the portal says "appeal cutoff date expired"?
faqs.a: That message means the 90-day window for that month has closed. You cannot appeal that month, but you can submit a new SRD application for a later month if your circumstances still meet the rules.

title: SASSA SRD Reconsideration vs Appeal
description: A reconsideration is a review of your SRD information; an appeal is a formal challenge to a decision. See the difference and the 90-day appeal route.
intro: People often say "reconsideration" when they mean an appeal. They are not the same. A reconsideration is a fresh look at your information; an appeal is a formal challenge lodged with the Independent Tribunal.
how_it_works: SASSA may review your eligibility when your information changes, such as corrected bank details or updated contact details.
That review is not a formal appeal, and it does not replace your right to appeal a declined month.
An appeal is lodged on the official portal at srd.sassa.gov.za/appeals/appeal and is decided by the Independent Tribunal, not by SASSA.
The appeal window is 90 days from the decision date. Do not assume that asking SASSA to review your information extends that window.
At the appeal stage you cannot add evidence that was not available to SASSA when you applied.
If you disagree with a decision, lodge the appeal within the 90 days rather than waiting for a review that may not change that month.

steps.title: Check the declined month and date
steps.text: Use the SRD status portal to identify the exact month and decision date. The 90-day appeal window runs from that date.

steps.title: Decide whether you are appealing
steps.text: If you disagree with the information SASSA used, lodge an appeal. If you are only updating details for future months, use the SRD portal instead.

steps.title: Lodge the appeal within 90 days
steps.text: Go to https://srd.sassa.gov.za/appeals/appeal with your ID, phone number and PIN. Open the declined month and choose the reason that fits your case.

steps.title: Update your details for future months
steps.text: Correct your bank or contact details on the SRD portal so the next monthly assessment uses accurate information. This does not change the outcome of the month you are appealing.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a SASSA reconsideration and an appeal?
faqs.a: A reconsideration is a review of your information, often after you correct details. An appeal is a formal challenge to a declined month, lodged with the Independent Tribunal on the official appeals portal. You do not need a reconsideration before lodging an SRD appeal.

faqs.q: Does a reconsideration stop the 90-day appeal clock?
faqs.a: Do not assume it does. The SRD rules set the appeal window from the decision date. If you want to challenge that month, lodge the appeal within 90 days.

faqs.q: How long does a reconsideration take?
faqs.a: There is no published fixed period for a review of your information. An appeal has a stated limit: the tribunal must finalise it within 90 days of receiving it.

title: SASSA SRD Appeals Portal: Lodge or Check
description: Use the official SASSA SRD appeals portal with your ID, phone number and PIN to lodge an appeal or check the outcome for a declined month.
intro: The Independent Tribunal for Social Assistance Appeals (ITSAA) decides SRD appeals. The official portal is where you lodge an appeal and check the outcome for a declined month.
how_it_works: The official portal is https://srd.sassa.gov.za/appeals/appeal. Old guides that list srd-appeals.dsd.gov.za are out of date; that address does not resolve.
Enter your 13-digit ID number and the 10-digit phone number used on your SRD application.
The portal sends a 6-digit PIN to that phone. There is no password to create.
After verification, the portal lists declined months. You appeal one month at a time.
The appeal is decided by the Independent Tribunal, which must finalise it within 90 days of receiving it.
You can check the outcome for the month on the same portal; a separate reference number is not required.
The portal is free and works in a normal mobile browser.

portal.name: SASSA SRD Appeals Portal
portal.note: Enter your 13-digit ID number and the 10-digit phone number used for your SRD application. The portal then sends a 6-digit PIN to that phone.

steps.title: Open the official portal
steps.text: Go to https://srd.sassa.gov.za/appeals/appeal in your browser.

steps.title: Enter your ID and phone number
steps.text: Type your 13-digit ID number and the 10-digit phone number linked to your SRD application.

steps.title: Send and enter the PIN
steps.text: Tap send pin. Enter the 6-digit PIN sent to that phone number.

steps.title: Lodge or check an appeal
steps.text: Open the declined month to lodge an appeal or see the outcome already recorded for that month.

faqs.q: Is the SASSA SRD appeals portal free?
faqs.a: Yes. It is a free government service. You need a working internet connection and the phone number linked to your SRD application.

faqs.q: Do I need a password for the appeals portal?
faqs.a: No. You verify with your ID number, your phone number and a 6-digit PIN sent to that phone.

faqs.q: Is srd-appeals.dsd.gov.za the official portal?
faqs.a: No. That hostname does not resolve. The official portal linked from SASSA is https://srd.sassa.gov.za/appeals/appeal. Update any bookmark or old guide that still points to the dsd address.

faqs.q: Can I appeal through WhatsApp or the Moya app?
faqs.a: No. Those channels can show your SRD application status, but the appeal must be lodged on the official appeals portal.

title: SASSA SRD Appeal Timeline: 90 Days
description: Lodge within 90 days of the decision. The Independent Tribunal must then finalise the appeal within 90 days of receiving it. See each stage.
intro: The SRD appeal has two separate 90-day periods: the window to lodge the appeal, and the period the Independent Tribunal has to finalise it after receiving it.
how_it_works: You have 90 days from the decision date to lodge the appeal on the official portal.
After the tribunal receives the appeal, it must finalise the appeal within 90 days.
The tribunal reassesses SASSA's decision on the information that was available at application. New evidence cannot be added at the appeal stage.
The decision is communicated electronically, and the outcome is recorded against the month on the appeals portal.
An approved appeal sets aside the declined decision. SASSA must implement the outcome, but payment timing is separate.
If the tribunal has not finalised the appeal within 90 days, follow up through official SASSA channels rather than paying an intermediary.

steps.title: Decision date (day 0)
steps.text: SASSA records a decision for the month. The 90-day window to lodge an appeal starts on this date.

steps.title: Lodge the appeal (within 90 days)
steps.text: Use https://srd.sassa.gov.za/appeals/appeal with your ID number, phone number and the 6-digit PIN. Open the declined month and choose an appeal reason.

steps.title: Tribunal receives the appeal
steps.text: The Independent Tribunal must finalise the appeal within 90 days from the date it receives it.

steps.title: Decision communicated
steps.text: The outcome is sent electronically and recorded on the portal for that month. Approved sets aside the decline; declined confirms it.

steps.title: Implementation and payment
steps.text: If the appeal succeeds, SASSA must implement the decision. Check your SRD status and the payment schedule for the next step; there is no guaranteed payment date from the appeal decision alone.

timeline.note: The 90-day appeal window starts from the decision date.
The portal rejects an appeal after the cutoff.
The tribunal reassesses the information SASSA already had.
The outcome is sent electronically and shown against the month.
Payment timing is separate and is not set by the appeal decision.

faqs.q: How long does a SASSA SRD appeal take in total?
faqs.a: The tribunal has up to 90 days from receiving the appeal to finalise it. If you lodge on the last day of your own 90-day window, the two periods can add up to about six months. That is the legal maximum, not a promise that a decision will take that long.

faqs.q: Why is my appeal taking longer than 90 days?
faqs.a: The 90-day period is a deadline for the tribunal, not a guarantee. If it passes with no outcome, check the portal and follow up through official SASSA channels. Do not pay anyone who claims they can speed up the tribunal.

faqs.q: When will I be paid after a successful appeal?
faqs.a: There is no fixed payment date in the appeal decision. An approved appeal means the tribunal set aside the decline; SASSA must then implement the outcome. Check your SRD status and the SASSA payment schedule for the month.
